ambiguities.source_text: How many appearances has each player made?
ambiguities.intent: Each starter has one appearance per valid match. Read the CSV as a raw grid; only positive integer match-number rows are matches.

ambiguities.source_text: SubX = Substitute Off, the player number who has left the field
ambiguities.intent: Off positions refer to original starter positions 1–11.

ambiguities.source_text: If a player was substituted in the 90th minute, then we count this as 1 appearance but 0 mins played
ambiguities.ref:
player_mins = {player: 90.0 for _, player in starting_xi}
                player_mins[sub_off_player] = sub_time
ambiguities.intent: Starters play 90 minutes unless replaced, in which case they play t minutes.

ambiguities.source_text: SubX 1 = Substitute On, the player number who is entering the field
ambiguities.intent: On positions refer to original bench positions 12–18.

ambiguities.source_text: How many appearances has each player made?
ambiguities.intent: An unused substitute has zero appearances; a substitute entering at minute 90 still has one appearance.

ambiguities.source_text: If a player was substituted in the 90th minute, then we count this as 1 appearance but 0 mins played
ambiguities.intent: A substitute entering at t plays max(0,90-t) minutes; otherwise zero.
